lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible high-luminance circular clusters (pixel maxima) are arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill area, with spatial coordinates following the lateral curvature of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are observed intersecting the circular maxima, particularly in the central flank region, forming a grid of luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple linear features oriented horizontally on the upper third of the flank exhibit a distinct vertical pixel intensity gradient, with high-luminance values on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow values on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple lower-luminance elongated shapes (remoras) positioned ventral to the pectoral fin and along the lower lateral region.
